nodes.description: Private reflection balance mapping _rOwned[address] used for the reflection accounting model.
Private token balance mapping _tOwned[address]; declared but unused in the transfer flow.
Nested allowance mapping _allowances[owner][spender] written by _approve().
Mapping marking addresses exempt from transfer fees and cooldown checks.
Blacklist mapping bots[address] consulted during every _transfer and set by owner-only setters.
cooldown[address] mapping storing the next allowed buy timestamp per account.
Total reflection supply _rTotal, reduced on every fee reflection.
Accumulated token fees _tFeeTotal, incremented in _reflectFee().
Tax fee rate _feeAddr1 (set to 2) used by _getTValues().
Team fee rate _feeAddr2 (set to 10) used by _getTValues().
payable fee recipient wallet 1, also the privileged caller for manualswap/manualsend.
payable fee recipient wallet 2 receiving half of the swapped ETH.
Stored IUniswapV2Router02 instance used for liquidity and swap operations.
Address of the created Uniswap V2 pair used as the trading gate condition.
Boolean gate controlling whether swaps/transfers to the pair are allowed.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token to ETH swapping inside _transfer().
Flag enabling the per-address buy cooldown enforcement.
Maximum transaction amount enforced in the cooldown branch of _transfer().
Ownable owner address checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, minting and transfer initiation.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for cooldown enforcement and router deadlines.
Transaction origin address, declared as an available untrusted input although not referenced.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards to _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount).
Public ERC20 transferFrom combining _transfer with an allowance decrease.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to the internal _approve().
Core internal transfer containing fee assignment, trading gate, blacklist, cooldown, max-tx and auto-swap logic.
Private lockTheSwap routine approving the router and swapping contract tokens for ETH.
Private routine splitting contract ETH between the two fee wallets.
Owner-only function enabling trading, swapping, cooldown and setting the max tx amount.
Owner-only function creating the Uniswap pair and adding initial ETH liquidity.
Owner-only function filling the bots blacklist mapping from an array.
Owner-only function removing an address from the bots blacklist.
Fee-wallet-only function forcing a swap of contract token balance for ETH.
Fee-wallet-only function forcing distribution of contract ETH to fee wallets.
Private dispatcher forwarding to _transferStandard().
Private routine computing rate-based values and mutating _rOwned balances, team and fee.
Private routine crediting the team portion as reflections to the contract itself.
Private routine reducing _rTotal and increasing _tFeeTotal.
Private view returning the six computed transfer values.
Private pure routine computing token fee, team fee and transfer amount.
Private pure routine converting token values into reflection values.
Private view computing rSupply.div(tSupply) as the reflection rate.
Private view returning current reflection and token supplies.
Private view converting a reflection amount into a token amount.
Private routine validating addresses and writing the _allowances mapping.
Owner-only toggler for the cooldownEnabled flag.
Deployment routine setting fee wallets, minting reflections to deployer and fee exclusions.
External router call transferring tokens and receiving ETH while contract state is mid-update.
External ETH send to wallet 1 executed inside the transfer flow.
External ETH send to wallet 2 executed inside the transfer flow.
External payable router call forwarding the whole contract ETH balance.
External unlimited approval granted to the router for the pair token.
External factory call creating the trading pair at a hardcoded router address.
SafeMath subtraction of the sender reflection balance; used as arithmetic sink.
SafeMath subtraction reducing the total reflection supply.
Division forming the reflection rate; rely on non-zero token supply.
Timestamp-derived cooldown write made dependent on miner-controlled block.timestamp.
Chained SafeMath subtraction computing the net transfer amount.
SafeMath multiplication converting token amounts to reflection amounts.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the implicit from address used by transfer().
recipient parameter is supplied to transfer().
amount parameter is supplied to transfer().
transfer() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() decreases the caller allowance through _approve().
sender parameter flows into transferFrom().
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom().
amount parameter flows into transferFrom().
approve() delegates to the internal _approve routine.
from parameter drives balance debits inside _transfer().
to parameter drives balance credits and pool checks inside _transfer().
amount parameter feeds fee computation inside _transfer().
_transfer() gates pool interactions on the tradingOpen flag.
_transfer() requires that from and to are not blacklisted in bots.
_transfer() reads and writes cooldown[to] to throttle buys.
block.timestamp is used for the cooldown require and write inside _transfer().
_transfer() enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount on pool buys.
_transfer() invokes swapTokensForEth() (external call) before the token balances are settled.
_transfer() invokes sendETHToFee(), sending ETH out during the token transfer flow.
contractTokenBalance local is computed and consumed inside _transfer().
contractETHBalance local is read and forwarded inside _transfer().
_transfer() finalises accounting through _tokenTransfer().
tokenAmount parameter is passed to the router swap in swapTokensForEth().
path local determines the swap route used by swapTokensForEth().
swapTokensForEth() performs the external router swap call that can re-enter the contract.
The external swap call targets the stored uniswapV2Router instance.
amount parameter is halved between the two fee wallets in sendETHToFee().
sendETHToFee() performs an ETH transfer to fee wallet 1.
sendETHToFee() performs an ETH transfer to fee wallet 2.
The ETH transfer uses the _feeAddrWallet1 state variable as target.
The ETH transfer uses the _feeAddrWallet2 state variable as target.
onlyOwner compares _owner before openTrading() executes.
msg.sender is compared against _owner by the onlyOwner modifier on openTrading().
openTrading() flips tradingOpen to true, enabling pool transfers.
openTrading() sets _maxTxAmount to 3e10 * 10**9.
openTrading() enables the automatic swap flag swapEnabled.
openTrading() enables cooldown enforcement.
onlyOwner restricts addLiq() to the owner.
addLiq() stores the newly created router instance.
addLiq() stores the created pair address.
addLiq() calls the factory createPair external function.
addLiq() forwards the full ETH balance through the external addLiquidityETH call.
addLiq() grants an unlimited allowance to the router for the pair token.
block.timestamp is used as the router deadline in addLiq().
bots_ array entries are written into the bots mapping by setBots().
setBots() mutates the bots blacklist used to block transfers.
onlyOwner restricts setBots() to the owner.
notbot address is written with false in delBot().
delBot() mutates the bots blacklist entry for the given address.
onlyOwner restricts delBot() to the owner.
manualswap() requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1, an address-based authorization check.
manualswap() calls swapTokensForEth() with the contract token balance.
manualsend() requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1, an address-based authorization check.
manualsend() forwards the entire ETH balance through sendETHToFee().
_tokenTransfer() forwards to _transferStandard().
_transferStandard() requests computed values from _getValues().
_transferStandard() subtracts rAmount from the sender reflection balance.
_rOwned balances of sender and recipient are rewritten with computed reflection values.
_transferStandard() takes the team portion via _takeTeam().
_transferStandard() reflects the fee via _reflectFee().
_getValues() calls _getTValues() for the token-side amounts.
_getValues() calls _getRValues() for the reflection-side amounts.
_getValues() reads the current reflection rate from _getRate().
tAmount parameter flows into _getValues().
tAmount parameter flows into _getTValues().
taxFee parameter flows into _getTValues().
TeamFee parameter flows into _getTValues().
tAmount parameter flows into _getRValues().
currentRate parameter flows into _getRValues().
_getTValues() performs chained subtractions for the net transfer amount.
_getRValues() multiplies token amounts by the current rate.
_takeTeam() credits _rOwned[address(this)] with the team reflection amount.
_takeTeam() reads the current rate before crediting reflections.
_reflectFee() decreases _rTotal by the fee reflection amount.
_reflectFee() increases _tFeeTotal by the fee token amount.
_reflectFee() subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_getRate() obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply().
_getRate() divides reflection supply by token supply.
tokenFromReflection() uses the rate returned by _getRate().
rAmount parameter is divided by the current rate in tokenFromReflection().
_approve() writes the _allowances mapping, controlling spending rights.
owner parameter is written into the allowance mapping by _approve().
spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping by _approve().
amount parameter is written into the allowance mapping by _approve().
_transfer() writes cooldown[to] from block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is the source of the cooldown deadline value.
The constructor assigns _feeAddrWallet1.
The constructor assigns _feeAddrWallet2.
The constructor mints the whole reflection supply to the deployer.
The constructor marks owner, contract and fee wallets as fee-excluded.
msg.sender becomes the owner during construction.
setCooldownEnabled() toggles the cooldown flag that gates pool buys.
onlyOwner restricts setCooldownEnabled() to the owner.
